text:
Predicates:
PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ::: x performs in school talent shows often.
AttendsSchoolEvents(x) ::: x attends school events.
Engaged(x) ::: x is very engaged with school events.
PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ∨ ¬ActiveMember(x) ::: People either perform in school talent shows often or are inactive members.
ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) ::: x chaperones high school dances.
AttendsSchool(x) ::: x attends the school.
YoungChildOrTeen(x) ::: x is a young child or teenager.
WishesToFurtherStudies(x) ::: x wishes to further her academic career and educational opportunities.
Student(x) ::: x is a student who attends the school.
AttendsAndEngaged(x) ::: x both attends and is very engaged with school events.
NeitherAttendsNorStudent(x) ::: x neither attends nor is a student.
Bonnie ::: Bonnie (constant).
Premises:
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) → AttendsSchoolEvents(x) ∧ Engaged(x)) ::: If people perform in school talent shows often, then they attend and are very engaged with school events.
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ∨ ¬ActiveMember(x)) ::: People either perform in school talent shows often or are inactive members.
∀x (ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) → ¬AttendsSchool(x)) ::: If people chaperone high school dances, then they are not students who attend the school.
∀x (ActiveMember(x) ∧ ¬AttendsSchool(x)) ::: All people who are inactive and disinterested members of their community chaperone high school dances.
∀x (YoungChildOrTeen(x) ∧ WishesToFurtherStudies(x)) → Student(x) ::: All young children and teenagers who wish to further their academic careers are students who attend the school.
Bonnie ::: Bonnie.
((AttendsAndEngaged(Bonnie) ∧ Student(Bonnie))) ∨ (¬AttendsAndEngaged(Bonnie) ∧ ¬Student(Bonnie))) ::: Bonnie either both attends and is very engaged, and is a student, or neither attends nor is a student.
Conclusion:
((WishesToFurtherStudies(Bonnie) ∧ ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(Bonnie))) ∨ (¬WishesToFurtherStudies(Bonnie) ∧ ¬ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(Bonnie))) → (Student(Bonnie) ∨ ¬ActiveMember(Bonnie)) ::: If Bonnie is either both a young child or teenager who wishes to further her academic career and chaperones high school dances or neither, then Bonnie is either a student who attends the school or an inactive member.
